cases.name: Melissa Molinari
cases.about:
Her longtime friend Victoria said, "She was completely selfless. She always did for everyone else before she did for herself."

https://www.foxnews.com/us/long-island-mother-four-slaughtered-husband-longed-be-wanted
cases.narrative: On 12/9/2021, her body was located in Rocky Point Pine Barrens State Forest. She was stabbed about 20 stab times in her back and chest and was found wrapped in towels and blankets. Police believe her husband stabbed her to death in the basement of their home on 11/21/2021. He never reported her missing but a friend did on 12/2/2021.
